Why virtual tours work in JP Nagar

JP Nagar is a family neighbourhood, and the decisions made here are family decisions — which school, which hospital, which apartment. Those choices are researched online long before anyone visits.

A 360° tour gives parents, patients and home buyers a clear look inside, so the site visit confirms what they already expect.

From one clinic to an entire campus

A single clinic or restaurant is usually captured in one visit. Hospitals, schools and apartment projects are planned area by area, around patient hours, school holidays or show-flat timings.

Frequently asked questions — JP Nagar

Do you shoot 360° virtual tours in JP Nagar?

Yes. Thamco360’s scan crew travels to businesses and properties across Bangalore, including JP Nagar, and deploys within 48 hours of booking. There is no studio to visit — the crew comes to you.

Can you capture an apartment show flat in JP Nagar?

Yes. Finished show flats, model apartments and rentals can be captured room by room, including balconies and shared amenities, and embedded on your project website.

Do you shoot school campuses in JP Nagar?

Yes. Campus shoots are scheduled on holidays, weekends or after school hours so no students are captured, and large campuses are planned building by building.

How much does a 360° virtual tour cost in JP Nagar?

Basic Thamco360 packages start from just ₹7,999. The final price depends on the size of the space, the number of scan points and any extras such as a website embed or custom 3D features.
